newsitem.title: USA: Pall Corp to buy Gelman Sciences.
newsitem.headline: Pall Corp to buy Gelman Sciences.

text.p: Pall Corp said on Monday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Gelman Sciences Inc, which it said has ended a merger pact with Memtec Ltd.

Pall said it would pay Pall common stocks valued at $33.00 for each share of Gelman common in the deal, as long as the Pall average closing price remains between $25.29 and $27.96 during a 30-day period before a Gelman shareholders' meeting.
Pall said the merger should be non-dilutive to its earnings per share in the first year and accretive thereafter.

Pall said Gelman has the right to end the agreement if Pall's average closing price falls below $21. Pall said if its average closing is $25.29 or less, the exchange ratio would be 1.3047 Pall shares for each Gelman share. If average closing is $27.96 or more, the ratio will be 1.1804 Pall shares for each Gelman share, Pall said.
The merger would be a tax-free reorganization accounted for as a pooling of interest, Pall said, adding that it is expected to occur in three to four months.
